title: Filter by a supplied Boolean predicate
specification:
def Spec (f : (Nat → Bool) → List Nat → List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ p xs, f p xs = xs.filter p
signature: (p : Nat → Bool) (xs : List Nat) : List Nat
